facts.fact: Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO officially launched the PI-SPI interoperable instant payment platform on 30 September 2025, with 80 institutions already connected and connection mandatory for all UEMOA financial institutions from 30 June 2026.
Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO's PI-SPI instant payment platform covers banks, microfinance, e-money and payment institutions across the UEMOA, Cote d'Ivoire's union.
